title: Stations
description: Stations is a survival-friendly fast travel plugin using 81 overworld stations with a GUI system at spawn. It includes home-linked nearest stations and balanced teleport mechanics to keep survival gameplay fair.
body:
🚉 Stations – Smart & Lightweight Teleport System

Stations is a modern, lightweight Minecraft plugin designed to enhance survival gameplay without breaking immersion. Instead of instantly teleporting everywhere, players can use stations as organized travel points, keeping the survival experience balanced while still making movement fast and convenient.

Built for performance and simplicity, Stations integrates smoothly into any Paper/Spigot server with minimal configuration and zero lag impact.

✨ Features
🚀 Fast & organized teleport system
Create custom stations players can travel between instantly.
🎮 Survival-friendly design
Keeps gameplay balanced while reducing unnecessary travel time.
⚙️ Highly configurable
Easily adjust messages, costs, cooldowns, and station behavior.
🧠 Simple commands
Clean and easy-to-learn commands for both players and admins.
🪶 Lightweight & optimized
Designed to run efficiently even on large servers.
🔒 Permission support
Fully compatible with permission plugins like LuckPerms.
🎯 Perfect For
Survival servers
Semi-vanilla experiences
RPG or roleplay worlds
Public multiplayer servers
Servers wanting balanced teleportation systems

⚡ Why Stations?

Unlike traditional teleport plugins, Stations focuses on structure and immersion. Instead of random warps or overpowered teleportation, players use meaningful travel points that feel like part of the world.

It’s not just teleporting — it’s a travel system built into your server’s gameplay.

🔧 Requirements
Paper / Spigot (recommended latest versions)
Java 17+
📌 Lightweight. Simple. Powerful.

Stations keeps things minimal, fast, and enjoyable — giving your server better movement without ruining survival gameplay.
